pull: Clue: She carried Churchill to meet Roosevelt
body:
Can you name this ship?

On 2 December 1941, this British battleship docked at Singapore with the battlecruiser Repulse and their destroyer escort, sent east to warn Japan off. Six months earlier she had traded fire with the Bismarck. Eight days after arriving, Japanese bombers and torpedo planes sank both big ships off the coast of Malaya.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
photoNote: HMS Prince of Wales coming in to moor at Singapore, dated 4 December 1941 by the IWM (the fleet docked on 2 December; the IWM date may be the caption or a second mooring). Lt H J Abrahams, Royal Navy official photographer, IWM A 6786. Crown copyright expired, public domain. Tier: green. No name or pennant number visible.
